{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmospheric sensors''' are devices that were used for seasonal data collection. They are noted to be best used on planets with tectonic or unstable terrains. During the [[Dark Wars]], [[Saedhe]] and the [[Khoonda Militia]] once placed hidden surveillance devices on a group of atmospheric sensors in order to monitor transmissions between [[Azkul]] and his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and a second source, which was most likely the [[Exchange]].
